name: Makarios III (Michael Christodoulou Mouskos)
role: Archbishop and President of Cyprus; president until the coup of July 1974, returned to office in December 1974
note: Contemporary photograph dated 29 July 1975, from the Museum of Yugoslavia / Presidency of the Republic photo service. CC BY-SA 3.0 RS (VRT permission confirmed). 640x480 original; depicts Makarios receiving Tito, with Makarios in clerical dress at left. Source image kept unaltered.

name: Glafkos Clerides
role: House Speaker and Eniaion leader; acting President during the July–December 1974 transition; Greek Cypriot negotiator
note: ICRC archive photo dated August 1974, Nicosia, during prisoner exchange/repatriation; Clerides is the man on the right. The archive says publication without restrictions; ICRC copyright. Original 3804x2573; kept unaltered.

name: Charalambos Charalambopoulos
role: Chief of the National Guard General Staff; Hellenic Army lieutenant general serving on assignment to Cyprus
note: Contemporary group photograph from the 9 February 1972 Athens meeting over the Czechoslovak arms shipment. The article caption identifies Greek ambassador Konstantinos Panagiotakos on the left, National Guard commander Charalambopoulos in the centre, and staff officer Ragkousis. Original source image is low resolution (249x179) and retained unaltered; image rights are unclear.

name: Georgios Denisis
role: Chief of the National Guard General Staff; Hellenic Army lieutenant general serving on assignment to Cyprus; opposed the July 1974 coup and did not lead it
note: Source image cropped from the two-person photo printed on p. 22 of XARAVGI/DIALOGOS, 6 July 2024; the caption identifies Denisis as the left-hand man in uniform and states that he opposed the coup and was summoned to Athens. Image reproduced without retouching; newspaper-photo reuse rights are unclear.

name: Mihail Georgitsis
role: Acting National Guard commander during the 15 July 1974 coup; coup participant, a short-lived crisis role rather than a routine chief appointment
note: Source image cropped from the two-person photo printed on p. 22 of XARAVGI/DIALOGOS, 6 July 2024; the caption identifies Georgitsis as the right-hand man in civilian clothing and states that he was assigned execution of the coup. Acting commander only during the 15 July 1974 coup. Image reproduced without retouching; newspaper-photo reuse rights are unclear.

name: Efthymios Karagiannis
role: Chief of the National Guard General Staff after the coup; Hellenic Army lieutenant general serving on assignment to Cyprus
note: Official GEEF timeline lists his term as 1974–1975. No reliable reusable portrait source located.

name: Ioannis Komninos
role: Chief of the National Guard General Staff; Hellenic Army lieutenant general serving on assignment to Cyprus
note: Official GEEF timeline lists his term as 1975–1981. No reliable reusable portrait source located.

name: Nikolaos Papanagiotou
role: Chief of the National Guard General Staff; Hellenic Army lieutenant general serving on assignment to Cyprus
note: Official GEEF timeline lists his term as 1981–1985. No reliable reusable portrait source located.
